objective: Prove what ticket C observed. (1) In a hub-free parity substitution (every fresh distinction in at most two knots, connected gadget), the replaced knot remains an implied check exactly when the gadget adds no open end (no distinction held by a single knot); then every step is a conservative extension, so bond distances between old distinctions never grow, and each original distinction gains new bond-2 neighbours at every level (collapse). (2) In a hub-free law whose knot graph is a tree, the bond distance between two open ends equals the number of knots on the path between them plus one; for the star tower this gives 3^k + 1. Check on random gadgets and random trees, with a non-tree control.
status: Proved (LOGIC-AXIS-20261107-001D-P001): open ends make a tower stretch. A hub-free substitution keeps the old knot exactly when its gadget adds no open end (distinction held by one knot); then each step is conservative, so the original distinctions stay bonded at distance 2 forever and gain bond-2 neighbours every level (collapse; the 2026-10-20 refinement is such a gadget). On tree-shaped knot graphs bond distance = path knots + 1, so the star tower stretches as 3^k + 1.
title: Open ends make a tower stretch
